text:
alex: Quick report: Node sampleapp loses x-request-id when our recommended fetch-retry wrapper triggers a retry. Repro below.

maria: oh no, that will break trace joins. only Node?

taylor: likely an OTEL hook ordering + Request clone problem. many retry libs create a new Request and headers get dropped.

alex: repro snippet: 
```js
const fetch = require('node-fetch');
const retry = require('fetch-retry')(fetch);
await retry('https://svc/generate', { retries:1, headers:{ 'x-request-id':'rid-42' } });
```
logs:
2025-02-14T09:10:01Z sampleapp DEBUG outgoing x-request-id=rid-42
2025-02-14T09:10:02Z sampleapp DEBUG outgoing x-request-id=-

kevin: mitigation options: inject requestId from AsyncLocalStorage in our OTEL http hook; or change quickstart to avoid fetch-retry.

taylor: agree ALS injection is pragmatic. Add allowlist to avoid re-injecting sensitive headers (no Authorization).

maria: please add a small e2e that simulates a 502 and asserts header preserved across retry. I'll open the issue.

telemetry-bot: Created issue #4410: "Node sampleapp: x-request-id lost on retry (fetch-retry)"

kevin: also check Go/Python sampleapps for parity. Alex can run quick checks tomorrow.
